description.en: Registers an object for the next HQ event, by role: 0 the stage map, 1 the camera, 2 any other object (characters, effects), placed in the first free slot (up to 14 of them). An HQ event (see RunHQEvent) plays its cuts with the objects registered here.
Always null (also when the slots are full or the role is not 0, 1 or 2, in which case nothing is registered).

examples.case: Setting up the first HQ event (real usage, from ev42010100.nut)
